svg.text: Dotnet · D02 · A query is a recipe until you enumerate it
Declare stores a recipe. Enumeration executes it.
IEnumerable runs here. IQueryable often becomes SQL.
Add(4) after Where still appears in the output.
2,4 — query was a recipe, not a snapshot
Any() then foreach runs the query twice.
ToList when you need one execution.
Name execution site, then enumeration count.
